name: stratx
description: Grounded research with verifiable citations. Runs a phased research engagement over a local corpus, emits claims with exact source spans, and flags what it could not support.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: An OpenRouter key (sk-or-...) or an Anthropic key (sk-ant-...). Detected automatically. Used only for reasoning and verification - indexing and retrieval are local and free.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id for grounded answers. Leave blank for a sensible default per provider.

grounding.title: Grounding backend
grounding.description: local (default, no external setup) or notebooklm (requires the notebooklm MCP and 'nlm login').

spend_cap_usd.title: Spend cap (USD)
spend_cap_usd.description: Soft ceiling per run. stratx stops and asks before exceeding it.
